- UPS raised its 2026 guidance and reported strong holiday demand projections with rising revenue per piece, signaling robust fleet utilization and healthy unit economics for delivery contractors [3, 5, 6].
- Landstar missed Q3 earnings due to rising commercial insurance costs and adverse claims adjustments, reinforcing broader commercial auto severity pressures and validating Nirvana's telematics model [2, 11].
